title: Isandro and the Drop
author: Hazel Okonkwo
blurb: Silas Reyes, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
